issues.desc: background.md ## Solution Tradeoffs references "(F-021 consistency)" without defining what F-021 is. A newly-onboarded reader has no way to know whether F-021 is a finding ID, a test case, or some other artifact, making the consistency requirement non-standalone-readable.
